newsitem.title: UK: Brockbank agrees to Mid Ocean offer.
newsitem.headline: Brockbank agrees to Mid Ocean offer.

text.p: British insurer Brockbank Group said on Tuesday it had agreed to an offer from Bermuda based Mid Ocean Limited for the remainder of Brockbank it does not already own.
In a statement, Brockbank, a Lloyds managing agency group, said both companies had agreed to a recommended offer to be made by J.P. Morgan on behalf of Mid Ocean for Brockbank at 696p per share.
The offer values the entire issued share capital of Brockbank at 85.5 million pounds ($142.6 million). Mid Ocean already held a 51 percent controlling interest in Brockbank.

Brockbank said the offer represents a 31 percent premium over the middle-market price at the close of business on April 7, the business day prior to the announcement that Mid Ocean was to make an offer for the rest of Brockbank.

"We are very pleased to be able to move towards the completion of what we began 18 months ago and to offer Brockbank shareholders appropriate liquidity for the outstanding 49 percent," said Mid Ocean President and Chief Executive Officer Michael Butt.
